name: @extas/customers
description: Customers (S14, BACKEND-ARCHITECTURE §5.5; Blueprint B5): one customer record keyed by phone, the single view over a person's merged profiles and numbers, the merge rules, merges and splits by a person only (nothing moves or is deleted) and who looked at a customer (PR 284); the Customers list with its views (PR 285). Phone numbers are masked for anyone without the full-number key.
